svg.title: The author asks for skills for tech strategy, high level design and low level design; Claude sends the request to start-task, which reads the plugin and states Route: Spec_Route with the task name design-skills, then asks one round of six questions.

g.text: ponderly — start-task
> I want to work on skills for tech stratey -> high level design(s) -> low level design(s) each as
a skill and similar to implement spec with some reviewres and stuff?
● This is a new feature for the plugin, so it goes through start-task. I'll hand it the request in
your words and let it read the plugin, size the work and start the spec questions.
⏺ Skill(skill: ponderly:start-task, args: I want to work on skills for tech strategy -> high level
design(s) -> low level design(s) each as a skill and similar to implement spec with some
reviewers and stuff?)
⏺ Bash(command: ls .ponderly/specs/ && echo --- && ls plugins/ponderly plugins/ponderly/skills
plugins/ponderly/agents plugins/ponderly/rules plugins/ponderly/hooks && echo --- && cat
plugins/ponderly/.claude-plugin/plugin.json && echo --- && wc -l
plugins/ponderly/skills/*/SKILL.md plugins/ponderly/agents/*.md plugins/ponderly/README.md
README.md && ls evals evals/skills evals/agents 2>/dev/null, description: List plugin layout,
specs, skills, agents, evals)
⏺ Bash(command: cat plugins/ponderly/README.md && echo ===== && cat
plugins/ponderly/agents/wave-reviewer.md && echo ===== && cat plugins/ponderly/rules/workflow.md
&& echo ===== && head -40 plugins/ponderly/skills/implement-spec/SKILL.md && echo ===== && ls
plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task/spec-template
plugins/ponderly/skills/report plugins/ponderly/skills/report/templates && echo ===== && head -20
plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task/SKILL.md, description: Read plugin README, reviewer agent,
workflow rule, skill heads)
⏺ Bash(command: cat plugins/ponderly/agents/wave-reviewer.md; echo '-----'; cat
plugins/ponderly/agents/task-executor.md, description: Read the two agent definitions)
⏺ Bash(command: cat plugins/ponderly/rules/workflow.md; echo '-----'; head -12
plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task/SKILL.md; echo '-----'; head -12
plugins/ponderly/skills/implement-spec/SKILL.md; echo '-----'; ls
plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task/spec-template
plugins/ponderly/skills/report plugins/ponderly/skills/report/templates
plugins/ponderly/skills/pr; echo '-----'; cat plugins/ponderly/hooks/hooks.json, description:
Read workflow rule, skill frontmatter, skill folders, hooks)
⏺ Bash(command: sed -n 1,80p evals/README.md; echo '-----'; ls evals/skills/start-task
evals/skills/start-task/summarises-requirements evals/agents/wave-reviewer; echo '-----'; cat
evals/skills/start-task/summarises-requirements/case.yaml; echo '-----'; ls checks; grep -n
'eval-' Makefile | head -30, description: Read eval README, a case layout, checks and Makefile
targets)
⏺ Bash(command: sed -n 1,60p plugins/ponderly/skills/start-task/spec-template/design.md; echo
'-----'; cat README.md | sed -n 1,124p, description: Read design template head and root README)
● **Route: Spec_Route.** Task name `design-skills`, branch `design-skills` (no issue named; `pr`
wants a ticket later, so if you file one the branch becomes `<number>-design-skills`). The plugin
has five skills and two agents, with `start-task` and `implement-spec` as the shape this extends:
a self-describing template per document, path-and-summary hand-backs, AskUserQuestion stops, a
reviewer agent that gathers the diff itself, and an eval case folder per behaviour.
Before I write the requirements, one round of questions. Answer in your own words, as much or as
little as you like.
1. **What each skill produces.** What is a tech strategy document to you: for one repository, or
for a product or organisation spanning several? What does a high level design cover (a system, a
service, a bounded context?) and a low level design (a module, a component, an API?). Can one
strategy have many HLDs, and one HLD many LLDs?
2. **How they chain.** Does an LLD feed into `start-task`, so a spec's `design.md` cites or is
derived from it, or does the chain end at the LLD? Does an HLD have to exist before an LLD can be
written, and a strategy before an HLD, or can someone start at any level?
3. **Where the documents live.** Under `.ponderly/` in the repository, like specs, or somewhere
else? One file per document, or a folder with sections like a spec?
4. **"Similar to implement-spec with some reviewers".** Which parts do you mean: a reviewer agent
reading each document before you approve it, with findings you see? Sub-agents writing sections
in parallel? A cadence choice? And are the reviewers agents, or does the skill also prepare the
document for human reviewers?
5. **Who it is for and the value.** The author writing the strategy or design, a team reading it
later, or both? What goes wrong today that these skills fix?
6. **Out of scope and constraints.** Anything you already know you do not want: no new
dependencies is a given, but for example no diagrams beyond Mermaid, no reading of external docs,
no ticket integration? Should each skill get evals and a free check like the others, and a
self-describing template with a worked example?
